rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for being extremely happy or pleased.

example.english: I was elated when I got a birthday present.
example.traditional: 我收到份生日禮物，真係好開心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sau1 dou2 fan2 saang1 jat6 lai5 mat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when the elation especially involves excitement or heightened energy.

example.english: I’m so elated about going on holiday tomorrow that I can’t sleep.
example.traditional: 聽日就去旅行，我興奮到瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 zau6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 ngo5 hing1 fan5 dou3 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use this colloquial emphatic phrase to stress that someone is exceptionally happy.

example.english: I was elated when I won concert tickets.
example.traditional: 抽中演唱會門票，我開心到飛起。
example.jyutping: cau1 zung3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 mun4 piu3 ngo5 hoi1 sam1 dou3 fei1 hei2
